mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) being at or below 0.25% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases the discount rate for equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong economy with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising >0.2% in 3 months AND UNRATE falling >0.3pp in 3 months
regime_hint: strong economy with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises by >0.2% in 3 months and UNRATE falls by >0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate above 1200 thousand units (HOUST > 1200) indicates strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is above 1200.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.0% (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts rate (HOUST) combined with a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rising >0.5% in 3 months AND INDPRO rising >0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST rises by >0.5% in 3 months and INDPRO rises by >0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: The level of employment (PAYEMS) being above 140,000 thousand persons indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is above 140,000.

mechanism_narrative: A transitory inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 235 and rising >0.5% in 3 months) signals that the economy is growing without excessive inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 235 AND CPIAUCSL rising >0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 235 and rising by more than 0.5% in 3 months.
